profile.name: 管道进程流接口
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件流接口组件，通过子进程的标准输入/输出进行字节流通信。在实验系统中可用于把协议栈、控制工具或辅助进程接入数据通道，负责读写和关闭进程管道流。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software stream interface component that communicates over a child process's standard input/output as a byte stream. In laboratory systems, it can be used to connect protocol stacks, control utilities, or helper processes into a data path, providing stream write, read, and close operations.

registry.name: Stream Pipe
registry.description: Stream Pipe是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、写入数据、打开、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot等操作。
